Pic-A
is
a
collection
of
three
chips:
Piattos, Nova, and Tostillias. They’re three
notable childhood chip brands here, and I
wanted to save up space in getting you to
try
them.
I
have
very
fond
memories
of
afternoons where school ends and I go to
the school canteen to purchase one of the
three — and often arrive at our house to
snack on some more stored in the cabinets.
I
made
sure
to
choose
the
“ultimate
cheddar” flavor — I’m curious to

know how Philippine cheese-flavored

snacks fare against the tastebuds of

someone from the largest cheese

exporter country in the world.
